responsibility: Implements the standalone host-side launcher for AMD GCN kernels compiled as HSA code objects. It dynamically loads the HSA runtime, discovers a GPU agent and memory regions, loads and freezes the executable image, resolves the init-array, main, and fini-array kernel symbols, allocates and populates device kernarg/heap structures defined by the GCN offload ABI, submits dispatch packets to an HSA queue, polls completion signals, and reports buffered device output and exit status, providing a way to execute non-libgomp GCN programs whose entry point uses a main-like argc/argv interface.
